title: Portfolio construction review knowledge
scope: Evidence and package boundaries for deterministic Core portfolio candidates.
guidance: Require each portfolio method to retain its own candidate outcome and solver attempts.
Treat diagnostic solvers and multistart sensitivity as evidence rather than fallback authority.
Use the owner specification for objectives, constraints, settings, and acceptance residuals.
assumptions: Portfolio construction consumes one exact downstream-eligible covariance candidate.
warnings: This resource does not select, approve, or publish a preferred portfolio.
